parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' — a path that sits squarely inside an Examples/SampleApp subtree. The canonical copy resides in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' (package: DebugPanel), while the duplicate in the Wallpaper package's sample app is almost certainly a local convenience copy pasted to keep the sample app self-contained without a hard dependency on the DebugPanel package. Extracting it would couple the sample app to a production library for a debug-only UI row, which is typically undesirable. The decision rule for 'sample-app-mirror' applies here.
